title: The Big Haul
note: b384 — first use of 'haul_net' (taut + landed states) and 'motion_arc'; reuses the b383 'pull'/'sprawl'/'spin' poses for the haul and the comic vaults.

pages.brief: Nell the bee gripping a rope attached to a large net at the pond edge, leaning back with all her weight. Comic scale — she is tiny, the net is not.
pages.alt: Nell the bee grips a rope attached to a large net at the pond edge, leaning back with all her weight — she is tiny, the net is not.

pages.brief: The rope stretched bar-straight and quivering, the net snagged on something under the water. Draw the tension in the rope itself.
pages.alt: The rope is stretched bar-straight and quivering — the net is snagged on something under the water.

pages.brief: Moss arriving and taking hold of the rope behind Nell, both leaning back in a line. Teamwork composition.
pages.alt: Moss arrives and takes hold of the rope behind Nell, both of them leaning back in a line — teamwork.

pages.brief: Both of them straining, feet dug in, faces screwed up with effort, the rope creeping in inch by inch. Sweat and determination.
pages.alt: Both of them strain with feet dug in, faces screwed up with effort, the rope creeping in inch by inch.

pages.brief: The net finally out on the bank, bulging with weed, an old boot and a great many small treasures. Detailed and rewarding to pore over.
pages.alt: The net is finally out on the bank, bulging with weed, an old boot and a great many small treasures — rewarding to pore over.

pages.brief: Nell doing a somersault in mid-air out of sheer delight, drawn as a looping motion arc with a yellow blur at the end.
pages.alt: Nell does a somersault in mid-air out of sheer delight, drawn as a looping motion arc with a yellow blur at the end.

pages.brief: Moss attempting the same somersault and getting it entirely wrong — mid-tumble, legs everywhere, spikes bristling. Hilarious.
pages.alt: Moss attempts the same somersault and gets it entirely wrong — mid-tumble, legs everywhere, spikes bristling. Hilarious.

pages.brief: Closing page: the pair sitting on the upturned boot beside their haul at sunset, exhausted and triumphant. Warm gold across the pond.
pages.alt: Closing page: the pair sit on the upturned boot beside their haul at sunset, exhausted and triumphant, warm gold across the pond.
